title: Chris Ramsay's own associative remote viewing training and results, which led to the Area 52 channel

tellings.quote: um we start getting really crazy results, like good results.

plain: Chris Ramsay, a Canadian online video maker, says that in 2023 he trained in associative remote viewing, a practice where people try to sense a hidden target with the mind and tie it to a predicted outcome, with a teacher named Brett Stewart. He says they started getting "really crazy results, like good results", and that this led him to start his Area 52 channel. If true, it would mean the mind can reach information it should not have.
